nodes.text:
All Mutual Funds should be allowed to launch pension-oriented MF schemes (MFLRS) with Uniform Tax Treatment as NPS :

 ‘Mutual Fund Linked Retirement Scheme’ (MFLRS), with similar tax benefits as applicable to NPS under Sec. 80CCD (1) & 80CCD (1B) of Income Tax Act, 1961, with ExemptExempt-Exempt (E-E-E) status on the principle of similar tax treatment for similar products.

nodes.author: Keval_IM
nodes.text:
Reduction in STT for Arbitrage Funds and Equity Savings Funds

Arbitrage Funds and Equity Savings Funds mainly use Futures and Options for hedging as the underlying assets. The available arbitrage has now been reduced due to increase in short term capital
gain tax. Further, the increased STT on futures will add to the cost of these funds.
